While the `topology_boundary_auditor` gave a high confidence score (0.92), this only means the segmentation model found a coherent region; it does not rule out subtle fusion with adjacent textures (hair/skin) which the Router visually identified. The visual evidence of 'melting' edges is strong.

The Router did not underestimate severities; the text gibberish alone warrants a very low artifact score.
